shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'cat package.json && cat tsconfig.json && cat next.config.ts && git status --short'

/bin/bash -lc "cat > app/Dashboard.test.tsx <<'EOF'
import { renderToStaticMarkup } from 'react-dom/server'
import { afterEach, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
import Dashboard from './Dashboard'

const getHeaders = vi.hoisted(() => vi.fn())
vi.mock('next/headers', () => ({ headers: getHeaders }))

afterEach(() => {
  vi.unstubAllGlobals()
  vi.resetAllMocks()
})

it('starts all requests together and displays successful responses when one fails', async () => {
  getHeaders.mockResolvedValue(new Headers({ host: 'example.test', 'x-forwarded-proto': 'https' }))
  const pending: Array<(response: Response) => void> = []
  const fetchMock = vi.fn(() => new Promise<Response>((resolve) => pending.push(resolve)))
  vi.stubGlobal('fetch', fetchMock)

  const dashboard = Dashboard()
  await vi.waitFor(() => expect(fetchMock).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(3))
  expect(fetchMock.mock.calls.map(([url]) => String(url))).toEqual([
    'https://example.test/api/analytics',
    'https://example.test/api/notifications',
    'https://example.test/api/settings',
  ])

  pending[0](Response.json({ views: 42 }))
  pending[1](new Response(null, { status: 503 }))
  pending[2](Response.json({ theme: 'dark' }))

  const html = renderToStaticMarkup(await dashboard)
  expect(html).toContain('views')
  expect(html).toContain('42')
  expect(html).toContain('Unable to load notifications.')
  expect(html).toContain('theme')
  expect(html).toContain('dark')
})
EOF
npx vitest run app/Dashboard.test.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('app/Dashboard.test.tsx')
s = p.read_text().replace(\"const fetchMock = vi.fn(() => new Promise<Response>((resolve) => pending.push(resolve)))\", \"const fetchMock = vi.fn((_url: URL, _options: RequestInit) => new Promise<Response>((resolve) => pending.push(resolve)))\")
p.write_text(s)
PY
npx tsc --noEmit --incremental false"
